caption: The drawing depicts a round, lidded wooden box shown from three different perspectives: with the lid on, with the lid off, and the lid by itself. The box is primarily dark blue or black with red edges and yellow decorative patterns, including swirls, leaves, and possibly stylized plant motifs on both the body and the lid. The lid features a central raised handle and matching floral or leaf patterns in red, yellow, and green, along with dotted accents. The sides of the box are adorned with yellow swirling designs and what appears to be a date or number "1846" and a flower-like motif on the front. The construction is wooden, with panels fitted together and small, raised vertical tabs at the four corners. The inside of the box is shown as a light wood color, distinct from the painted exterior. The artist's name, "WILLIAM SPRECKER," is printed in the lower right corner of the page.
title: Butter Box
